title: PAF retires Huey helicopters after nearly six decades of service
summary: The Philippine Air Force (PAF) has decommissioned its entire fleet of Bell UH-1H Iroquois “Huey” helicopters, ending nearly six decades of service for the military aircraft type in the country.
